newsitem.title: INDIA: CRICKET-BOMBAY WIN INDIA'S RANJI TROPHY.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-BOMBAY WIN INDIA'S RANJI TROPHY.

text.p: Bombay won India's Ranji Trophy final on Wednesday. With only two innings completed they were declared winners over Delhi on the basis of a 71-run first innings lead.

Scores: Bombay first innings 630 (Amol Mazumdar 144, Jatin Paranjpe 111, Vinod Kambli 89, Sanjay Manjrekar 78, Wasim Jaffar 58), Delhi first innings 559 (Ashu Dani 178, Ajay Sharma 176, Nilesh Kulkarni 4-143).
